title: Our School Board Endorsements

verify.note: Page is undated, but every pick is for an A/B subdistrict seat, which is first elected at the Nov 3, 2026 general (only that election fills these seats); all 17 names and seat labels match the page.

note: Transcribed from the page by a researcher. Chicago political group backing "independent school board candidates who put students first" (education-policy stances: outcomes, financially sound choices). General election: "Page "Our School Board Endorsements" lists A/B subdistrict seats (e.g. "1B - Michelle Pierre", "10B - Patrick Watson"), which exist only at the Nov. 3, 2026 general (Chicago's first fully elected board; e.g. Neal is running "to succeed Biggs"). The page itself does not print the date."
